datasets.name: 2-metre air temperature
datasets.source: Supplied NASA Giovanni export of MERRA-2 monthly air temperature
datasets.spatial_support: Giovanni area-average export; contributing centre is 25N, 66.875E (one native cell).
limitations: Temperature is retained in kelvin, without conversion to Celsius.
Reanalysis is not a direct satellite temperature measurement.

datasets.name: Precipitation rate
datasets.source: Supplied NASA Giovanni export of IMERG Final satellite-gauge precipitation
datasets.spatial_support: Giovanni area-averaged monthly series; individual grid-cell histories are absent.
limitations: The original export uses inch/day. The application converts rates to mm/hr using 25.4 / 24, with the conversion recorded in metadata.
Each monthly row remains a rate, not an accumulated monthly rainfall total; annual summation of rates is not performed.
Coverage ends in January 2025; the remainder of 2025 is not supplied.

datasets.name: Evapotranspiration rate
datasets.source: Supplied NASA Giovanni export of GLDAS Noah monthly evapotranspiration
datasets.spatial_support: Giovanni area-averaged monthly series; individual grid-cell histories are absent.
limitations: Model-derived evapotranspiration includes evaporation and transpiration.
The native mass-flux unit is retained; this is not a monthly accumulated depth.

datasets.name: Soil moisture content (0–10 cm)
datasets.source: Supplied NASA Giovanni export of GLDAS Noah monthly soil moisture
datasets.spatial_support: Giovanni area-averaged monthly series; individual grid-cell histories are absent.
limitations: Model-derived mass of water per unit area in the top 10 cm; not volumetric m3/m3.

datasets.name: Vegetation greenness (NDVI)
datasets.source: Supplied MOD13A3 monthly NDVI statistics export, grouped in the Karachi source folder
datasets.spatial_support: One contributing pixel per monthly record; pixel coordinates are not included in this export.
limitations: Karachi is the supplied folder association; the pixel location is unverified. Do not interpret this as a city-wide NDVI result.
Quality flags and extraction metadata are not supplied.
Exported decimal NDVI values are retained without additional scaling.

datasets.name: Aerosol optical thickness (550 nm)
datasets.source: Supplied NASA Giovanni export of MERRA-2 total aerosol extinction optical thickness
datasets.spatial_support: Giovanni area-average export; contributing centre is 25N, 66.875E (one native cell).
limitations: Optical thickness is not ground-level PM2.5 concentration or an air quality index.
MERRA-2 aerosol reanalysis is not a direct measurement of local exposure.
